capabilityHints.summary: Deploy the immutable game contracts, create and initialize one hooked WETH pool, lock its initial liquidity, collect actual-settlement fees, and settle pull-based game liabilities.

components.summary: Authenticated exact-input challenge route that binds payer, player, and beneficiary to its caller.
Fee and round-accounting kernel bound to one canonical WETH and OVERTIME PoolKey.
Deterministic deployment and atomic pool initialization plus permanent liquidity-lock orchestration.
Fixed-supply OVERTIME ERC-20 with no transfer tax, blacklist, administrator, or post-construction mint path.
Irreversible custodian for the initial Uniswap v4 position claim.

project.summary: A recurring leader-time game implemented as a fee-enforcing Uniswap v4 hook, with knockout or decision settlement, crown-time rewards, and permanently locked initial liquidity.
project.title: Overtime v1
